build_bytetrie_from_tokenizer: build a ByteTrie from a HuggingFace tokenizer using ByteTrie.from_tokenizer(tokenizer)
search_bytetrie_for_word: search the ByteTrie for a word using trie.search(word) to check existence
traverse_bytetrie_with_bfs: traverse the ByteTrie with BFS using trie.bfs(predicate) to find valid byte sequences
get_token_acceptance: get next token acceptance using trie.get_next_token_acceptance(accept) to filter valid tokens
visualize_bytetrie_structure: visualize the ByteTrie structure using trie.visualize(max_depth) to inspect the trie
